newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Minnesota Mining lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Minnesota Mining lowered.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Wednesday it lowered its intermediate-term rating on the shares of Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co to neutral from accumulate, based on valuation, but it kept its long-term buy rating on the stock.
-- Analyst Robert Curran said he still expected Minnesota Mining to post healthy earnings and he had not changed any estimates, but the stock had reached its price target.
-- "The downgrade was done solely on a valuatoin basis," he said. "We have recommended the shares since the middle of last year and the stock has done very well."
-- Minnesota Mining was trading off 3/16 at 100-9/16.
